summary: Comprehensive testing of PainSignal Iteration 5: Full rebrand from IdeaRadar to PainSignal + X/Twitter live scraping features. All 18 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend UI tests pass. Branding correctly shows 'PainSignal' throughout the app.
critical_code_review_comments: All branding correctly shows 'PainSignal' (navbar, landing page, auth page, pricing, footer)
HTML page title is correct: 'PainSignal | Find What to Build'
POST /api/scrape/x correctly returns 402 for free users
POST /api/scrape/x works for premium users (falls back to AI discovery when X API unavailable)
GET /api/scrape/status returns live_ideas count, last_scraped, and x_configured status
Live ideas appear in feed with live:true flag and source:twitter
IdeaCards show blue LIVE badge for live-scraped ideas
Dashboard has 'Scrape X Now' button (disabled for free, enabled for pro)
Dashboard has 'Live Pain Point Discovery' section with Radio icon
All existing features still work: auth, pricing, analytics, PDF export, scan topic
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 verified: 1) Full rebrand to PainSignal complete - no IdeaRadar references in user-facing UI, 2) X/Twitter scraping works with AI fallback when X API unavailable, 3) Live ideas have live:true flag and show LIVE badge, 4) 6 live ideas currently in DB from background scrape, 5) All existing features (auth, pricing, analytics, PDF export, scan topic) still working, 6) Theme toggle works in both dark and light modes.

branding_rebrand.details: All user-facing branding shows 'PainSignal': navbar, landing page hero, auth page heading, pricing page, footer. HTML title is 'PainSignal | Find What to Build'. localStorage keys use 'painsignal_token' and 'painsignal_theme'.

scrape_x_endpoint.details: POST /api/scrape/x returns 401 without auth, 402 for free users, 200 for premium users. Falls back to AI-powered trend discovery when X API credentials fail.

scrape_status_endpoint.details: GET /api/scrape/status returns live_ideas count (6), last_scraped timestamp, and x_configured (true).

live_ideas_in_feed.details: Live ideas appear in feed with live:true flag and source:twitter. Filter by Twitter/X shows 14 results including live-scraped ideas.

live_badge_ui.details: IdeaCards show blue LIVE badge for live-scraped ideas. Badge uses #1DA1F2 color (Twitter blue).

scrape_x_button_ui.details: Dashboard has 'Scrape X Now' button with data-testid='scrape-x-btn'. Disabled for free users (grayed out with PRO badge), enabled for pro users (blue button).

live_discovery_section.details: Dashboard has 'Live Pain Point Discovery' section with Radio icon and description 'Pull real complaints from X/Twitter in real-time'.

ai_scan_filter.details: Source filter includes 'AI Scan' option with data-testid='source-ai_scan'.

existing_auth.details: Login, register, forgot password, reset password all working correctly.

existing_pricing.details: 3-tier pricing (Free, Pro, Business) displayed correctly. Stripe checkout works.

existing_analytics.details: User analytics endpoint returns all required fields. Analytics page accessible via Dashboard link in user menu.

theme_toggle.details: Theme toggle works on all pages. Dark and light modes render correctly.

mocked_apis_list: X/Twitter API search — falls back to AI-powered GPT-4o trend discovery when X API credentials fail (free tier limitations)
Stripe uses test key (sk_test_emergent) - creates real test checkout sessions
Password reset code returned in API response (demo mode - no email service)
